title: Meditate, pray or watch football instead of spreading hate - Infantino
summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino responds to critics by suggesting they meditate, pray, or watch football instead of spreading rumors about him and the World Cup. The comment reflects ongoing criticism of his leadership and characterizes dissent as "hate and false rumours."
content: Fifa president Gianni Infantino tells critics to "meditate, pray or watch a football match" instead of "spreading hate and false rumours" about him and the World Cup.

zh.title: 冥想、祈祷或看足球，而不是传播仇恨 - 因凡蒂诺

title: Record Spurs spend shows new ambition - Van de Ven
summary: Tottenham defender Micky van de Ven attributes the club's record-breaking transfer spending to renewed ambition following an "unacceptable" previous season. The substantial investment signals the club's determination to compete at higher levels after disappointing performances.
content: Micky van de Ven says Tottenham's record spending highlights a "new ambition" after an "unacceptable" season.

title: Podcast: League Cup Shocks, Celtic movement & St Johnstone concerns

The coverage highlights emerging talents and form fluctuations across Scottish clubs competing in various competitions.
content: Dunfermline impress, St Johnstone struggle and Celtic get moving.

content: Celtic bid for midfielder turned down amid conflicting reports over winger's proposed move to Scottish champions.

title: How many midfielders do Rangers need after busy summer of recruitment?

content: Rangers have a team full of central midfielders, but are they good enough to provide enough ammunition for their strikers?

title: Rogers and Palmer can play together - Alonso
summary: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso indicates he has a strategic plan to deploy record £117 million signing Morgan Rogers alongside Cole Palmer in the team's attacking setup. Alonso's confidence suggests both expensive attacking talents can function effectively together on the pitch.
content: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso says he has a "plan" to play club record £117m signing Morgan Rogers alongside Cole Palmer.

zh.title: 罗杰斯和帕尔默可以一起踢球 - 阿隆索

content: RB Leipzig winger Yan Diomande agrees personal terms with Real Madrid after Paris St-Germain withdraw their interest.

title: Glamour club Wrexham proving it can produce its own

content: Despite the club's high-profile recruitment, there remains a firm desire to develop the next generation of homegrown talent.
